items.title: Cowboys Beat Cardinals 34-13 in Preseason
items.one_line: Joe Milton threw for 179 yards and two first-half TDs in Dallas's 34-13 win at State Farm Stadium, with most starters resting.

items.title: Undrafted Rookie Jack Strand Shines in Falcons' Preseason Rout
items.one_line: Strand went 12 of 17 for 212 yards, a TD pass, and a rushing score in Atlanta's 34-6 win over Indianapolis; Penix was cleared for full practice in the same cluster.

items.title: Ravens Dominate Vikings 13-3 in Preseason Road Win
items.one_line: Baltimore's defense stuffed Minnesota at U.S. Bank; undrafted Ethan Burke had a sack, TFL, forced fumble, and two PDs in limited snaps.

items.title: Rookie Ja'Mori Maclin Hits 71-Yard TD in Bills' Preseason Win
items.one_line: Undrafted Maclin broke a 71-yard score in Buffalo's 31-7 win at Cleveland; Watson drew home boos in relief.

items.title: Bengals Dominate Bears 27-9 in Preseason at Paycor Stadium
items.one_line: Caleb Williams went 2-for-5 for 28 yards before Chicago settled for field goals; Cincinnati moved to 2-0 preseason.

items.title: Bears Rookie Jordan van den Berg Shines in Preseason Loss
items.one_line: Sixth-round DT van den Berg disrupted blocks and pressured the QB in the 27-9 loss at Cincinnati.

items.title: No-Call Hip-Drop Tackle on Bears' Loveland Draws Scrutiny
items.one_line: A hip-drop on Colston Loveland went unflagged in the Bengals game; Loveland stayed in. Ben Johnson flagged a Williams miss.

items.title: Bengals Dominate Bears 27-9 in Preseason at Paycor Stadium
items.one_line: Josh Johnson threw for 156 yards and two scores as Cincinnati's backups handled Chicago in a 27-9 win.

items.title: Browns QB Drama Peaks as Watson Booed, Sanders Shines in Preseason Loss
items.one_line: In a 31-7 loss to Buffalo, Shedeur Sanders went 9-of-11 for 74 yards with a TD and a pick; Watson was 5-of-12 amid home boos he called personal. Todd Monken names the Week 1 QB Monday.

items.title: Nick Chubb Retires from NFL at Age 30 After Stellar Career
items.one_line: The four-time Pro Bowler posted a 'Batman out' goodbye. He starred in Cleveland after Georgia and is 30.

items.title: Browns Lose Alex Wright to Season-Ending Achilles Injury, Sign Derek Barnett
items.one_line: Wright tore his Achilles in a joint practice vs Buffalo and went on IR. Cleveland signed Barnett (one-year, up to $5.5M); Isaiah McGuire is the projected starter opposite Myles.

items.title: Cowboys Beat Cardinals 34-13 in Preseason
items.one_line: Milton threw for 179 yards and two TDs in the first half at State Farm; Dallas starters mostly sat.

items.title: Michigan Rookies Barham and Moore Shine in NFL Preseason Debuts
items.one_line: Cowboys third-rounder Jaishawn Barham drew 'rocking heads' praise from Schottenheimer in his debut.

items.title: Lions Edge Commanders 17-13 in Preseason with Dobbs' 50-Yard TD Run
items.one_line: Joshua Dobbs' 50-yard score sealed it; Jayden Daniels played three snaps (0-for-1, a sack). Derrick Moore had a sack and forced fumble.

items.title: Fans Highlight Anthony Richardson's Athletic Runs in Colts Preseason Loss
items.one_line: Richardson was 3 of 9 for 24 yards and rushed three times for 15 in a 34-6 loss to Atlanta; the clips were the room.

items.title: Jaguars Sign DT Tommy Akingbesote, Waive Injured CB Devon Marshall
items.one_line: Jacksonville added the 2025 seventh-round DT and waived Marshall with an injury designation after a preseason hurt.

items.title: Jaguars WR Parker Washington Returns to Practice After Injury Scare
items.one_line: Washington rejoined drills at the Miller Electric Center; OT Chuma Edoga also came back.

items.title: Chiefs Preseason Losing Streak Hits 1,092 Days
items.one_line: Kansas City fell 16-15 at Tampa Bay after a 9-0 halftime lead (three Butker FGs, including a 69-yarder). Mahomes sat.

items.title: Harrison Butker's 69-Yard Preseason Field Goal Stuns Buccaneers Crowd
items.one_line: Butker hit 69 yards as time expired in the first half; it would break the NFL record if it counted. Tampa still won 16-15.

items.title: Clip of Justin Fields' Hesitation Draws Criticism in Chiefs Preseason Loss
items.one_line: Fields started in Mahomes' place (9 of 12, 64 yards) and a hesitation clip drew the usual pile-on.

items.title: Chargers Place Center Tyler Biadasz on Season-Ending IR After Knee Injury
items.one_line: Biadasz tore his ACL (and more) in a joint practice vs San Francisco. Jake Slaughter is the projected starter next to Slater and Alt.

items.title: Chargers Fans Puzzle Over Herbert's Offensive Line Setup in Camp
items.one_line: First-team OL: Slater-Pipkins-Slaughter-Strange-Alt, with Pipkins at LG for a second straight day.

items.title: Rams Shut Out Saints 34-0 in Preseason
items.one_line: Stetson Bennett led the backups and DB Alex Cook returned a pick 100 yards in a 34-0 win. Kellen Moore stressed execution over the score.

items.title: Jevon Holland Celebrates Giants' Preseason Blowout Over Old Team Dolphins
items.one_line: Giants won 26-3 at Hard Rock; Holland, now in New York, posted a blunt 'W' story. Trey Moore left with an ankle; Miami claimed CB Jai'Onte' McMillan.

items.title: Dolphins Rookie Trey Moore Out with Ankle Injury
items.one_line: Jeff Hafley said Moore will miss time after an awkward landing in the Giants game. Ollie Gordon II (ribs) is fine; Ronnie Harrison Jr. has a hamstring tweak.

items.title: Dolphins Claim Rookie CB Jai'Onte' McMillan Off Waivers from Colts
items.one_line: Miami claimed the undrafted TCU/Minnesota corner mid-game and released Nick McCloud.

items.title: Vikings' 322-Pound Rookie Drops into Coverage in Preseason Surprise
items.one_line: Brian Flores sent third-round NT Domonique Orange into coverage on 2nd-and-9 in a 13-3 loss at Baltimore.

items.title: J.J. McCarthy's Rough Preseason Sparks Vikings QB2 Debate
items.one_line: McCarthy went 5-of-10 for 81 yards vs the Ravens; the room is arguing whether Carson Wentz is passing him for QB2.

items.title: Patriots Edge Eagles 24-21 in Preseason Thriller at Gillette
items.one_line: Behren Morton hit Nick DeGennaro for the late winner. Vrabel sat Drake Maye. Eagles RB Ja'Quinden Jackson left for hospital evaluation.

items.title: Patriots' Boutte Mentors Rookie DeGennaro After First TD
items.one_line: Kayshon Boutte handed DeGennaro the ball back after the 37-yard game-winner and told him not to drop it.

items.title: Rams Shut Out Saints 34-0 in Preseason
items.one_line: New Orleans was blanked at SoFi; Kellen Moore said the score was about execution, not the final number.

items.title: Jevon Holland Celebrates Giants' Preseason Blowout Over Old Team Dolphins
items.one_line: New York won 26-3 at Hard Rock behind Winston (150 pass, a rushing TD) and outgained Miami 390-102.

items.title: Giants Rookie Arvell Reese Dominates in Preseason Win Over Dolphins
items.one_line: The fifth-overall pick wrecked gaps in 10-11 snaps and drew 'lead blocker's worst nightmare' tape talk.

items.title: Giants Get Positive Injury Updates on Nabers, Mauigoa and Ezeudu
items.one_line: Malik Nabers (knee) may drop the red jersey this week; Francis Mauigoa (stinger) is close; Josh Ezeudu is day-to-day.

items.title: Eagles Fall to Patriots as Backups Shine in Preseason Loss
items.one_line: Philadelphia lost 24-21 at Gillette. Andy Dalton 3-of-10; Tanner McKee 16-of-22 for 173 and two scores. Carson Steele had 117 total yards and a TD.

items.title: Eagles Backup Line Shines in Preseason Loss to Patriots
items.one_line: Rookie RT Markel Bell, C Willie Lampkin, LG Drew Kendall, and RG Jake Majors opened run lanes including a 13-play Shipley TD drive.

items.title: Steelers Release Rookie Kicker Laith Marjan After Preseason Miss
items.one_line: Pittsburgh cut Marjan after a 44-yard miss vs the Jets. Chris Boswell is the unchallenged starter heading into Buffalo.

items.title: Steelers Fans Speculate on Joey Porter Jr. Extension After Social Media Hints
items.one_line: Porter posted hourglass/stadium stories; the room is reading them as contract smoke. No deal reported.

items.title: Seahawks Backups Shred Titans Defense Before Rookie Injury Mars Preseason Win
items.one_line: Drew Lock hit Elijah Arroyo for a TD and Jacardia Wright went 69 yards vs Tennessee's starters. Second-round S Bud Clark left on a cart with a serious lower-leg injury.

items.title: Seahawks Sit Rookie RB Jadarian Price for Final Preseason Games
items.one_line: Mike Macdonald and John Schneider are holding the first-rounder out vs Tennessee and Kansas City with Charbonnet and Emanuel Wilson already dinged.

items.title: 49ers Activate Kittle from PUP List After Achilles Recovery
items.one_line: George Kittle came off Active/PUP, opening a possible Week 1 return vs the Rams in Melbourne on Sept. 10. McCaffrey was back from a planned rest.

items.title: Steve Smith Sr. Calls 49ers Rookie De’Zhaun Stribling Future WR1
items.one_line: Stribling (33rd overall, Ole Miss) had 11 catches for 109 yards vs Titans and Chargers; a shoulder issue has him day-to-day.

items.title: Bucs Rookie Rueben Bain Jr. Impresses in Preseason Debut with Bane Facemask
items.one_line: The 15th pick generated pressure vs Kansas City in a 16-15 comeback win and drew a strong PFF pass-rush grade in limited snaps.

items.title: Cam Ward Faces Seahawks in Key Titans Preseason Test
items.one_line: Ward was slated for 20-25 snaps after a 5-of-12, 57-yard opener vs San Francisco. Seattle's backups scored on the first two drives vs Tennessee's starters.

items.title: Seahawks Backups Shred Titans Defense Before Rookie Injury Mars Preseason Win
items.one_line: Lock-to-Arroyo and a 69-yard Wright run punched Tennessee's first-team defense; Bud Clark's injury was the Seattle-side headline.

items.title: Lions Edge Commanders 17-13 in Preseason with Dobbs' 50-Yard TD Run
items.one_line: Jayden Daniels played three snaps (0-for-1 plus a sack) in a 17-13 loss at Detroit.
